case_number: 2025 INSC 206; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. OF 2025 (arising out of SLP(Crl.) No. 9244 of 2024)
summary: Conviction under IPC s.302 and s.109 challenged; eyewitness accounts doubted due to delayed disclosure and inconsistencies; ballistic and postmortem reports inconclusive; motive linked to property dispute and inter-caste marriage opposition; prosecution failed to prove guilt beyond reasonable doubt; conviction set aside; appellant acquitted and ordered release.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; conviction set aside; appellant to be released from jail unless detained in another case.
